verses.en: And when Rehoboam was come to Jerusalem, he gathered of the house of Judah and Benjamin an hundred and fourscore thousand chosen men, which were warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.
verses.pt: E quando veio Roboão a Jerusalém, juntou da casa de Judá e de Benjamim cento e oitenta mil homens escolhidos de guerra, para lutar contra Israel e voltar o reino a Roboão.
verses.en_web: When Rehoboam had come to Jerusalem, he assembled the house of Judah and Benjamin, one hundred eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors, to fight against Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.
verses.en_bbe: And Rehoboam came to Jerusalem, and got together the men of Judah and Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand of his best fighting-men, to make war against Israel and get the kingdom back for Rehoboam.

verses.en: But the word of the LORD came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
verses.pt: Mas foi palavra do SENHOR a Semaías homem de Deus, dizendo:
verses.en_web: But Yahweh’s word came to Shemaiah the man of God, saying,
verses.en_bbe: But the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah, the man of God, saying,

verses.en: Speak unto Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,
verses.pt: Fala a Roboão filho de Salomão, rei de Judá, e a todos os israelitas em Judá e Benjamim, dizendo-lhes:
verses.en_web: “Speak to Rehoboam the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Say to Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin,

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD, Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren: return every man to his house: for this thing is done of me. And they obeyed the words of the LORD, and returned from going against Jeroboam.
verses.pt: Assim disse o SENHOR: Não subais nem luteis contra vossos irmãos; volte-se casa um a sua casa, porque eu fiz este negócio. E eles ouviram a palavra do SENHOR, e voltaram-se, e não foram contra Jeroboão.
verses.en_web: ‘Yahweh says, “You shall not go up, nor fight against your brothers! Every man return to his house; for this thing is of me.”’” So they listened to Yahweh’s words, and returned from going against Jeroboam.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has said, You are not to go to war against your brothers: let every man go back to his house, for this thing is my purpose. So they gave ear to the words of the Lord and were turned back from fighting against Jeroboam.

verses.en: And Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defence in Judah.
verses.pt: E habitou Roboão em Jerusalém, e edificou cidades para fortificar a Judá.
verses.en_web: Rehoboam lived in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah.
verses.en_bbe: Now Rehoboam kept in Jerusalem, building walled towns in Judah.

verses.en: He built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa,
verses.pt: E edificou a Belém, e a Etã, e a Tecoa,
verses.en_web: He built Bethlehem, Etam, Tekoa,
verses.en_bbe: He was the builder of Beth-lehem and Etam and Tekoa

verses.en: And Beth-zur, and Shoco, and Adullam,
verses.pt: E a Bete-Zur, e a Socó, e a Adulão,
verses.en_web: Beth Zur, Soco, Adullam,
verses.en_bbe: And Beth-zur and Soco and Adullam

verses.en: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,
verses.pt: E a Gate, e a Maressa, e a Zife,
verses.en_web: Gath, Mareshah, Ziph,
verses.en_bbe: And Gath and Mareshah and Ziph

verses.en: And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,
verses.pt: E a Adoraim, e a Laquis, e a Azeca,
verses.en_web: Adoraim, Lachish, Azekah,
verses.en_bbe: And Adoraim and Lachish and Azekah

verses.en: And Zorah, and Aijalon, and Hebron, which are in Judah and in Benjamin fenced cities.
verses.pt: E a Zorá, e a Aijalom, e a Hebrom, que eram em Judá e em Benjamim, cidades fortes.
verses.en_web: Zorah, Aijalon, and Hebron, which are fortified cities in Judah and in Benjamin.
verses.en_bbe: And Zorah and Aijalon and Hebron, walled towns in Judah and Benjamin.

verses.en: And he fortified the strong holds, and put captains in them, and store of victual, and of oil and wine.
verses.pt: Fortificou também as fortalezas, e pôs nelas capitães, e alimentos, e vinho, e azeite;
verses.en_web: He fortified the strongholds, and put captains in them, and stores of food, oil and wine.
verses.en_bbe: And he made the walled towns strong, and he put captains in them and stores of food, oil, and wine.

verses.en: And in every several city he put shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong, having Judah and Benjamin on his side.
verses.pt: E em todas as cidades, escudos e lanças. Fortificou-as pois em grande maneira, e Judá e Benjamim lhe estavam sujeitos.
verses.en_web: He put shields and spears in every city, and made them exceedingly strong. Judah and Benjamin belonged to him.
verses.en_bbe: And in every town he put stores of body-covers and spears, and made them very strong. And Judah and Benjamin were his.

verses.en: And the priests and the Levites that were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their coasts.
verses.pt: E os sacerdotes e levitas que estavam em todo Israel, se juntaram a ele de todos seus termos.
verses.en_web: The priests and the Levites who were in all Israel stood with him out of all their territory.
verses.en_bbe: And the priests and Levites who were in all Israel came together to him from every part of their country.

verses.en: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem: for Jeroboam and his sons had cast them off from executing the priest’s office unto the LORD:
verses.pt: Porque os levitas deixavam seus campos e suas possessões, e se vinham a Judá e a Jerusalém: pois Jeroboão e seus filhos os lançavam do ministério do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Judah and Jerusalem; for Jeroboam and his sons cast them off, that they should not execute the priest’s office to Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: For the Levites gave up their living-places and their property, and came to Judah and Jerusalem; for Jeroboam and his sons had sent them away, not letting them be priests to the Lord;

verses.en: And he ordained him priests for the high places, and for the devils, and for the calves which he had made.
verses.pt: E ele se fez sacerdotes para os altos, e para os demônios, e para os bezerros que ele havia feito.
verses.en_web: He himself appointed priests for the high places, for the male goats, and for the calves which he had made.
verses.en_bbe: And he himself made priests for the high places, and for the images of he-goats and oxen which he had made.

verses.en: And after them out of all the tribes of Israel such as set their hearts to seek the LORD God of Israel came to Jerusalem, to sacrifice unto the LORD God of their fathers.
verses.pt: Além daqueles acudiram também de todas as tribos de Israel os que haviam posto seu coração em buscar ao SENHOR Deus de Israel; e vieram-se a Jerusalém para sacrificar ao SENHOR, o Deus de seus pais.
verses.en_web: After them, out of all the tribes of Israel, those who set their hearts to seek Yahweh, the God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to sacrifice to Yahweh, the God of their fathers.
verses.en_bbe: And after them, from all the tribes of Israel, all those whose hearts were fixed and true to the Lord, the God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to make offerings to the Lord, the God of their fathers.

verses.en: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong, three years: for three years they walked in the way of David and Solomon.
verses.pt: Assim fortificaram o reino de Judá, e confirmaram a Roboão filho de Salomão, por três anos; porque três anos andaram no caminho de Davi e de Salomão.
verses.en_web: So they strengthened the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam the son of Solomon strong for three years; for they walked three years in the way of David and Solomon.
verses.en_bbe: So they went on increasing the power of the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, strong for three years; and for three years they went in the ways of David and Solomon.

verses.en: And Rehoboam took him Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David to wife, and Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse;
verses.pt: E tomou-se Roboão por mulher a Maalate, filha de Jeremote filho de Davi, e a Abiail, filha de Eliabe filho de Jessé.
verses.en_web: Rehoboam took a wife for himself, Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David and of Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Jesse.
verses.en_bbe: And Rehoboam took as his wife Mahalath, the daughter of Jerimoth, the son of David and of Abihail, the daughter of Eliab, the son of Jesse;

verses.en: Which bare him children; Jeush, and Shamariah, and Zaham.
verses.pt: A qual lhe gerou filhos: a Jeus, e a Samaria, e a Zaaão.
verses.en_web: She bore him sons: Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
verses.en_bbe: And she had sons by him, Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.

verses.en: And after her he took Maachah the daughter of Absalom; which bare him Abijah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.
verses.pt: Depois dela tomou a Maaca filha de Absalão, a qual lhe pariu a Abias, a Atai, Ziza, e Selomite.
verses.en_web: After her, he took Maacah the daughter of Absalom; and she bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.
verses.en_bbe: And after her he took Maacah, the daughter of Absalom; and she had Abijah and Attai and Ziza and Shelomith by him.

verses.en: And Rehoboam loved Maachah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and threescore concubines; and begat twenty and eight sons, and threescore daughters.)
verses.pt: Mas Roboão amou a Maaca filha de Absalão sobre todas suas mulheres e concubinas; porque tomou dezoito mulheres e sessenta concubinas, e gerou vinte e oito filhos e sessenta filhas.
verses.en_web: Rehoboam loved Maacah the daughter of Absalom above all his wives and his concubines; for he took eighteen wives and sixty concubines, and became the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.
verses.en_bbe: Maacah, the daughter of Absalom, was dearer to Rehoboam than all his wives and his servant-wives: (for he had eighteen wives and sixty servant-wives, and was the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.)

verses.en: And Rehoboam made Abijah the son of Maachah the chief, to be ruler among his brethren: for he thought to make him king.
verses.pt: E pôs Roboão a Abias filho de Maaca por cabeça e príncipe de seus irmãos, porque queria fazer-lhe rei.
verses.en_web: Rehoboam appointed Abijah the son of Maacah to be chief, the prince among his brothers; for he intended to make him king.
verses.en_bbe: Rehoboam made Abijah, the son of Maacah, chief and ruler among his brothers, for it was his purpose to make him king.

verses.en: And he dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his children throughout all the countries of Judah and Benjamin, unto every fenced city: and he gave them victual in abundance. And he desired many wives.
verses.pt: E fez-lhe instruir, e dispersou todos os seus filhos por todas as terras de Judá e de Benjamim, e por todas as cidades fortes, e deu-lhes alimentos em abundância, e buscou para eles muitas mulheres.
verses.en_web: He dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his sons throughout all the lands of Judah and Benjamin, to every fortified city. He gave them food in abundance and he sought many wives for them.
verses.en_bbe: And in his wisdom he had his sons stationed in every walled town through all the lands of Judah and Benjamin; and he gave them a great store of food, and took wives for them.
